title: Claude Code SKILL.md front matter
description: Mirrors https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills. Every field is optional to Claude Code itself; this schema additionally requires description, because a skill without one cannot be selected reliably.

name.description: Display name. Must match the containing directory, which is what sets the /command name.

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it. Resident in every session. Combined with when_to_use and truncated at 1536 characters in the listing.

when_to_use.description: Extra trigger phrases. Appended to description and counts toward the same 1536 character cap.

allowed-tools.description: Tools pre-approved for the invoking turn. Real Claude tool names, e.g. Read, Grep, Bash.

disable-model-invocation.description: true keeps the skill out of automatic loading; invoke it with /name only.

paths.description: Globs that limit automatic activation to matching files.
